_comment: Item 5 corner envelope, spec row 11 (loop power excluding the VCO core), stage 2 of the spec C-grid.
Circuit: CML prescaler + M/A divider at N = 100 driven at 5.0 GHz (design/netlist/{prescaler,divider}.spice). PFD + CP + bias, lock detector, reference and clock buffering are NOT in this circuit.
Per corner: ipavg / idavg = mean supply current of each rail over 40n-120n; tfb = 3 FB periods (rise 1 to rise 4 after 40n); 3 x 19.5-20.5 ns means the divider divides to 50 MHz.
Power limits are NOT set on the requests: the 20 mW budget needs PFD+CP+bias added and the owed blocks; the record grades it.
Issue #97 fix attempt 1 (AC-coupled self-biased cml2cmos first inverter): same grid as request-stage2.json, timeout_s 1800 (16 of 18 corners hit the 600 s limit in the first pass).

RESISTOR LOADING (issue #452): repaired in place -- this deck instantiates PDK rppd/rhigh resistors (PR #169) but carried no resistor model, so ngspice aborted at parse (unknown subckt rppd). Added cornerRES.lib (SLOW/TYP/FAST = res_wcs/res_typ/res_bcs) and the r3_cmc OSDI, as res_stage2() in make_requests.py does (issue #164). Regenerating this file from its make_* generator reintroduces the gap; re-run repair_res_loading.py afterwards.

measurements.name: ipavg
measurements.spice: .meas tran ipavg avg i(vddp) from=40n to=120n

measurements.name: idavg
measurements.spice: .meas tran idavg avg i(vddd) from=40n to=120n

measurements.name: tfb
measurements.spice: .meas tran tfb trig v(fb) val=1.65 td=40n rise=1 targ v(fb) val=1.65 td=40n rise=4

measurements.name: fbmax
measurements.spice: .meas tran fbmax max v(fb) from=40n to=120n

measurements.name: fbmin
measurements.spice: .meas tran fbmin min v(fb) from=40n to=120n

measurements.name: pspp
measurements.spice: .meas tran pspp pp v(psp) from=40n to=120n
